#library
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(Boruta)
library(xgboost)
library(SHAPforxgboost)
library(vegan)
```

```{r}
winter_fun<- readRDS("1_processed_data/otu_winter.rds") 
winter_fun_rclr <- readRDS("1_processed_data/otu_winter_rclr.rds")# roubust centriod log transformed dataset
winter_meta <- readRDS("1_processed_data/meta4snp_winter.rds")
field_winter <- readRDS("1_processed_data/field_winter.rds")
field_winter |> colnames()
field_winter <- field_winter |> select(Plot,S,N,mean_SN) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Plot,mean_SN),names_to = "Side",values_to = "above_ground_biomass") 
  
```

## make sure microbiome, snp, biomass merged with each other
```{r}
winter_fun_tss <- winter_fun |> t() |> decostand("total")


winter_fun_tss_filter <- winter_fun_tss[,colSums(winter_fun_tss>0.0005)>0.05*nrow(winter_fun_tss)] # only include microbes have relative abudance > 0.05% in more than 10% of the samples
dim(winter_fun_tss_filter);dim(winter_fun_tss)


winter_fun_rclr_f <- winter_fun_rclr[,colnames(winter_fun_tss_filter)]


meta_field_winter <- winter_meta |> left_join(field_winter)

table(is.na(meta_field_winter$above_ground_biomass)) # check if we have NAs in above ground biomass (mean_SN, average biomass from the South and North of the plot)

meta_field_winter <- meta_field_winter |> filter(!is.na(above_ground_biomass))# remove the samples with NAs in aboveground biomass

## remove samples without snp data/does't have above ground biomass from microbial feature table
winter_fun_fs_df <- winter_fun_tss_filter[meta_field_winter$sampleid,]
dim(winter_fun);dim(winter_fun_fs_df)  # check the numer of samples

# 1144 samples were input for model training
```

# filter microbiome data
```{r}
table(rownames(winter_fun_fs_df)==meta_field_winter$sampleid) # make sure they merged
dataX <- winter_fun_fs_df
y_var <- meta_field_winter$above_ground_biomass
```
# step 1 boruta based on random forest to identify microbes significantly contribute to biomass
```{r}

set.seed(45)
boruta_input <- data.frame(dataX, biomass = y_var)
boruta_result <- Boruta(biomass ~ ., data = boruta_input, doTrace = 1 )
```

```{r}
# Extract confirmed important features
confirmed_feats <- getSelectedAttributes(boruta_result, withTentative = F)

# Subset input data
dataX_boruta <- dataX[, confirmed_feats]
dataX_boruta |> dim()
```

# step 2 xgboost to rank the importance
## 2.1 get the best  iteration
```{r}
# Step 1: Explicitly reassign as a clean data.frame
dataX_clean <- data.frame(dataX_boruta, check.names = FALSE, check.rows = FALSE)

# Step 2: Force matrix conversion
dataX_mat <- as.matrix(dataX_clean)

# Step 3: Double check it is a numeric matrix
stopifnot(is.numeric(dataX_mat))

# Step 4: Create DMatrix
xgb.data <- xgb.DMatrix(data = dataX_mat, label = y_var)



params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  eta = 0.02,             # Keep low for stability
  max_depth = 5,          # Reduce tree depth to prevent overfitting
  gamma = 0.1,             
  subsample = 0.8,        # Add some regularization by row
  colsample_bytree = 0.8 # Limit feature sampling to prevent dominance of noisy features
)


# Early Stopping
cv_model <- xgb.cv(
  data = xgb.data,
  params = params,
  nrounds = 1000,                # Max number of boosting rounds
  nfold = 5,                     # 5-fold cross-validation
  early_stopping_rounds = 20,   # Stop if no improvement in 20 rounds
  verbose = 1,
  metrics = "rmse"              # Root Mean Square Error for regression
)

best_nrounds <- cv_model$best_iteration  #get the best_nrounds
```

# step 2.2 model 
```{r}
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(dataX_mat)), size = 0.8 * nrow(dataX_mat)) # train the model with 80% of the samples, and validate with the rest of 20%

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = dataX_mat[train_idx, ], label = y_var[train_idx])
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = dataX_mat[-train_idx, ], label = y_var[-train_idx])

xgb.model <- xgboost(
  data = dtrain,
  params = params,
  nrounds = best_nrounds,
  verbose = 0
)

y_test_pred <- predict(xgb.model, dtest)
y_test_obs <- y_var[-train_idx]

# External performance
rmse_test <- sqrt(mean((y_test_obs - y_test_pred)^2))
rsq_test <- 1 - sum((y_test_obs - y_test_pred)^2) / sum((y_test_obs - mean(y_test_obs))^2)
mae_test <- mean(abs(y_test_obs - y_test_pred))

cat("TEST SET -- RMSE:", rmse_test, "\nR²:", rsq_test, "\nMAE:", mae_test)
```

# lme 

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)
library(car)
library(lmerTest)
```
## create input dataset for lme
```{r}
### use rclr_data for input 
dataX_mat
otu_lme_input_winter <- winter_fun_rclr_f[rownames(winter_fun_rclr_f)%in%rownames(dataX_mat),colnames(winter_fun_rclr_f)%in%colnames(dataX_mat)]


lme_input <-otu_lme_input_winter  |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column("sampleid") |> 
  left_join(select(meta_field_winter,sampleid,Col,Row,Entry,above_ground_biomass))



# create a new data frame to save the results
lme.results<- data.frame(otu = character(),
                             Estimate = numeric(),
                             P_Value = numeric(),
                             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# get the otu list
otu_cols<- colnames(dataX_mat)

# calculate 
for (otu in otu_cols) {
  # fit the model
 fit <- lmer(above_ground_biomass ~ lme_input[[otu]] + (1 | Entry)+ (1 | Row)+ (1 | Col), data = lme_input)
  
  # extract the fixed effect
  estimate <- fixef(fit)[2]
  
  # calculate the p values
  summary_fit <- summary(fit)
  p_value <- summary_fit$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  # outputdata
  lme.results<- rbind(lme.results, data.frame(otu = otu, Estimate = estimate, P_Value = p_value))
}

# results
lme.results$p_adj <- p.adjust(lme.results$P_Value,method="fdr")
dim(lme.results)
table(lme.results$p_adj>0.05)
```
## 4.1 shapviz
```{r}
## 1 shapviz
library(shapviz)
sv <- shapviz(xgb.model, X_pred = dataX_mat[train_idx, ])

shap_mean <- sv %>%
  get_shap_values() %>%
  as.data.frame() |> 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(abs(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "mean_abs_shap") %>%
  arrange(mean_abs_shap)


# SHAP matrix
shap_mat <- get_shap_values(sv)
feat_mat <- get_feature_values(sv)

shap_mat_df <- as.data.frame(shap_mat)
feat_mat_df <- as.data.frame(feat_mat)

shap_dir <- lapply(colnames(shap_mat_df), function(v) {
  x <- feat_mat_df[[v]]
  y <- shap_mat_df[[v]]
  r <- suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  data.frame(variable = v, shap_cor = r)
}) |> 
  dplyr::bind_rows()
```
## 4.2. Taxonomic labels
```{r}
# Read taxa
  taxa <- readRDS("1_processed_data/taxonomy.rds")
otu_to_label <- taxa |> 
  select(otuid,Genus) |> 
   mutate(label = paste0(Genus, "_", otuid)) %>%
  select(otuid, label) %>%
  deframe()

```

## 43. Combine SHAP + LME + Reorder
```{r}
# Combine SHAP + LME
shap_lme <- shap_mean %>%
  # 加入 SHAP 方向信息
  left_join(shap_dir, by = "variable") %>%
  # 再连上 LME 结果
  left_join(lme.results, by = c("variable" = "otu")) %>%
  mutate(
    logP = -log10(p_adj),
    sig_group = ifelse(p_adj <= 0.05, "Significant", "Non-significant"),
    slope = ifelse(p_adj <= 0.05, Estimate, 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(sig_group = factor(sig_group, levels = c("Significant", "Non-significant")))


shap_lme <- shap_lme %>%
  mutate(
    # SHAP 方向（可以设置一个很小的阈值防止极小相关）
    shap_sign = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(shap_cor) ~ NA_character_,
      shap_cor >  0.05 ~ "Positive",
      shap_cor < -0.05 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE             ~ "Ambiguous"
    ),
    # LME 方向
    slope_sign = dplyr::case_when(
      slope >  0 ~ "Positive",
      slope <  0 ~ "Negative",
      slope == 0 ~ "Non-significant",
      TRUE       ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # SHAP 和 LME 是否同号
    direction_match = dplyr::case_when(
      slope_sign %in% c("Positive", "Negative") &
        shap_sign %in% c("Positive", "Negative") &
        slope_sign == shap_sign ~ "Consistent",
      slope_sign %in% c("Positive", "Negative") &
        shap_sign %in% c("Positive", "Negative") &
        slope_sign != shap_sign ~ "Inconsistent",
      TRUE ~ "Undefined"
    )
  )

# ---- keep only slope != 0
shap_lme_f <- shap_lme %>%
  # ① LME 显著
  filter(slope != 0) %>%
  # ② SHAP 和 LME 方向一致
  filter(direction_match == "Consistent") %>%
  mutate(
    slope_sign = factor(slope_sign, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(slope_sign) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_shap), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()
shap_lme_conflict <- shap_lme %>%
  filter(slope != 0, direction_match == "Inconsistent")
dim(shap_lme_conflict)

# final order
variable_order <- shap_lme_f$variable

shap_lme_f <- shap_lme_f %>%
  mutate(variable_ranked = factor(variable, levels = variable_order))

# labels follow same order
otu_to_label_ranked <- otu_to_label[levels(shap_lme_f$variable_ranked)]


```


```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(ggbeeswarm)




# Long format
shap_long <- shap_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "shap_value")

feat_long <- feat_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "feature_value")

# Combine + keep only slope!=0 otus + ranked factor
shap_long <- shap_long %>%
  mutate(feature_value = feat_long$feature_value) %>%
  filter(variable %in% shap_lme_f$variable) %>%
  left_join(shap_lme_f %>% select(variable, variable_ranked), by = "variable") %>%
  mutate(variable_ranked = factor(variable_ranked, levels = levels(shap_lme_f$variable_ranked)))

# Clipping after filtering
lower_clip <- quantile(shap_long$feature_value, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
upper_clip <- quantile(shap_long$feature_value, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

shap_long <- shap_long %>%
  mutate(feature_value_clip = pmax(pmin(feature_value, upper_clip), lower_clip))

# p_shap
p_shap <- ggplot(shap_lme_f, aes(x = 6 * mean_abs_shap, y = variable_ranked)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    data = shap_long,
    aes(x = shap_value, y = variable_ranked, color = feature_value_clip),
    alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5, width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_abs_shap, 3)),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    begin = 0.25, end = 0.85, option = "inferno",
    name = NULL,
    breaks = c(lower_clip, upper_clip),
    labels = c("Low", "High"),
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      title = NULL,
      label.position = "bottom",
      label.hjust = c(0, 1),
      barwidth = unit(80, "mm"),
      barheight = unit(2, "mm"),
      ticks = FALSE
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = otu_to_label_ranked,
    limits = rev(levels(shap_lme_f$variable_ranked))  # ⭐ same order
  ) +
  labs(title = "SHAP based on XGBoost", y = NULL, x = "SHAP value") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# p_lme
p_lme <- ggplot(shap_lme_f, aes(x = "otu", y = variable_ranked)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = logP, color = slope), alpha = 0.8, shape = 15) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "grey", high = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Slope in LME"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10(p_adj)") +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = otu_to_label_ranked,
    limits = rev(levels(shap_lme_f$variable_ranked))  # ⭐ same order
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "LME") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 0),
    legend.position="top"
  )
# Combined plot
combined_plot <- p_shap + p_lme + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(9, 1))
combined_plot

# Save results (use shap_lme or shap_lme_f depending on what you want)
shap_lme_out <- shap_lme_f %>%
  left_join(taxa %>% select(otuid, genus), by = c("variable" = "otuid"))

write.csv(shap_lme_out, "feature_selection/fun_winter_output.csv")

ggsave("feature_selection/fun_winter.pdf", combined_plot, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("feature_selection/fun_winter.png", combined_plot, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)


# 基于 LME + SHAP 结果进行分类
pie_data_lme2 <- shap_lme %>%
  mutate(
    lme_shap_group = case_when(
      slope != 0 & direction_match == "Consistent"   ~ "LME sig + SHAP consistent",
      slope != 0 & direction_match != "Consistent"   ~ "LME sig, SHAP inconsistent/ambiguous",
      slope == 0                                     ~ "LME non-significant",
      TRUE                                           ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(lme_shap_group)   # 相当于 table(...) |> as.data.frame()

pie_data_lme2

p_lme_confirmation2 <- ggplot(pie_data_lme2, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = lme_shap_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "LME sig + SHAP consistent"              = "#458A74",  # 绿色：核心 biomarker
      "LME sig, SHAP inconsistent/ambiguous"   = "red4",  # 棕色：有信号但不稳定
      "LME non-significant"                    = "#848484"   # 灰色：不显著
    )
  )

p_lme_confirmation2

ggsave(
  "feature_selection/lme_shap_confirmation_pie_winter.pdf",
  p_lme_confirmation2,
  width = 3, height = 3, dpi = 300
)
 

ggsave("feature_selection/lme_confirmation_pie_winter.pdf",p_lme_confirmation2,width=2,height=2,dpi=300 )

```

# M&M

To identify the microbes that significantly contribute to the barley biomass, a 3-step selection were performed: first, boruta based on were performed , xgboost with shape explainer were performed to indicate their relative importance, and lme model with genotype as random effect were further used to comfirm their contribution to biomass.
